note: Beep patterns heard at power-on. Counts vary by BIOS maker and board generation, so a match is a pointer for the technician. Verify against the service manual for the exact model before acting.
sources: AMI BIOS beep codes (American Megatrends BIOS documentation, POST beep code table)
Dell desktop beep codes (support.dell.com, diagnostic beep code reference for OptiPlex and XPS)
IBM PC POST beep codes (IBM technical reference, power-on self test tones)

patterns.short:1: AMI: DRAM refresh failure. Dell legacy: no memory detected in some generations.
patterns.short:2: AMI: parity circuit failure. Dell legacy: possible memory issue in some generations.
patterns.short:8: AMI: display memory read or write failure.
patterns.long:1 short:2: Common video adapter pattern on several BIOS makers: check the display path and reseat the graphics card where one is fitted.
patterns.long:1 short:3: Common video or memory pattern on several BIOS makers: check seating of memory and any graphics card.
patterns.continuous: Repeated or continuous tone: power, overheating or a stuck key on several BIOS makers. Check cooling and the keyboard first.
